notes.title: What's Next?
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pVUEUv-qLv0;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings!

Kill Spree's identity has ripened. After months of research, development, testing, and thought; the true potential of Kill Spree has been discovered! The fast-paced action, fluid movement, arcade mechanics, voice lines and announcers perfectly fits our revised identity.

What is Kill Spree?

Kill Spree is a first-person, armed and melee combat, adrenaline-pumping deathsports event that pits fighters against one another in majestic stadiums across the world.

Some words/phrases which describe the future of Kill Spree:

• Arcade
• Vibrant
• Stylized realism
• Epic
• Play for fun
• Casual
• Soundtrack
• Fast-paced
• Social
• Interactive
• Collaborative
• Free roam
• Home

Till next time,
Wunzero

notes.title: Play The Demo Prototype!

Over,
Wunzero

notes.title: Super Important Announcement
notes.content:
Listen up, soldiers.

Kill Spree is a next-level passion project, created because our favorite first-person shooter (FPS) game was heavily neglected by unwise companies. There's no game like Kill Spree when it comes to movement mechanics and kill satisfaction. The planned social and interactive user-interface idea is also a game changer, and has never been done before in any FPS game.

The only thing we asked from the community, since the foundation of Kill Spree, was to take part in surveys and help us get known by spreading the word. Your help is needed the most now. We need an investment to continue steady development of Kill Spree, and investors only fund high potential projects. Let's work as a team to ensure Kill Spree demo is super successful for the Steam release. We need to create shock and awe. To best achieve this, we must:


 wishlist on Steam and tell others to do the same
 tell a friend to tell a friend
 tell your family members
 play when the demo releases on Steam
 support us on our social media accounts
 create videos and livestreams
 give us constructive criticism on our Discord chat
 don't allow the few haters to manipulate your thoughts about us and the game; think independently

Kill Spree isn't for everyone. We serve people who:


 love to move freely in-game
 love great soundtracks
 want to feel like a badass when killing opponents
 chills when not playing seriously; to feel cozy
 played old-school Korean FPS games

Please keep in mind that Kill Spree is in Early Access phase. The upcoming Steam demo will have bug fixes, performance improvements, gameplay changes and some new content. Future versions of Kill Spree will only be available on Steam. This is the game we were missing. Help us, help you. Stay positive and God bless.

With gratitude,
Wunzero
